new_learnings.text: 云天化 entry at 44.05 on 2/26 was during a period when stock was ~15% above MA10. Despite being a磷化工龙头 with ROE 25% and 8 highlights, the -6.56% loss was driven by mean reversion from overextended entry. V2 Rule 2b (MA distance check) would have prevented this entry entirely. This is the most expensive lesson of the portfolio: NEVER enter when dist_ma20>12%, regardless of thesis quality. The entry timing matters more than fundamental quality for momentum trading.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks >12% above MA20 have high mean-reversion risk. Even sector leaders with perfect fundamentals pull back to MA support before continuing higher. Entry timing > thesis quality for short-term momentum.

new_learnings.text: 科达制造 time stop at day 10 with +1.83% PnL fires despite stock showing +3.37% daily gain on exit day (hit 18.53 intraday). The restructuring catalyst (特福国际 51.55% acquisition) is real but slow-moving — audit/evaluation still in progress per 1/28 预案. V2 time stop correctly identifies that if a catalyst hasn't moved the stock meaningfully in 10 days, timing is wrong. Restructuring catalysts have uncertain timelines. Can re-enter when approval comes.
new_learnings.mechanism: Restructuring catalysts have multi-month timelines. Holding through dead time has opportunity cost. Time stop forces capital rotation into stocks with active momentum. The +3.37% daily gain on exit day is noise — what matters is the 10-day cumulative return.

new_learnings.text: 3/9→3/10 sector rotation was extreme and instructive: oil/gas/coal surged on 3/9 (中东冲突 drove COMEX gold to $5400, oil services led market) then crashed on 3/10 (-5.5%), while tech/equipment/materials crashed on 3/9 then surged on 3/10 (+2.5-5.2%). Single-day sector spikes driven by geopolitical events are NOT sustainable trends. Only buy sectors with multi-week persistence (电网设备 since May 2025, 专用设备 since Nov 2025). This validates Rule 1: follow persistent sector trends, not one-day spikes.
new_learnings.mechanism: Geopolitical event-driven sector spikes attract hot money that exits within 1-2 days. Structural sector trends driven by policy (十五五电网投资4万亿) or industry cycles (燃机供需缺口, GE合同量+80%) persist for months and are safer to ride.

new_learnings.text: IV Rank at 8.8% (avg across 4 ETFs) with 300ETF IV percentile at 2.1% — market is more complacent than 97.9% of the past year. This is the lowest IV reading since tracking began. The 50% sizing reduction rule for IV<15% is critical: all 3 new positions sized at 3-5% instead of normal 6-10%. When vol is this cheap, a spike is coming within 2-4 weeks. Protect capital with smaller positions.
new_learnings.mechanism: Extremely low IV = market pricing in minimal future volatility. IV mean-reverts — when at historical lows, vol expansion is likely within 2-4 weeks. Smaller positions protect against the inevitable vol spike while still participating in momentum.
